scope: Woodford, Interest and Prices, Chapter 2: Price-Level Determination under Interest-Rate Rules, with Appendix A. Asset pricing, the intertemporal budget constraint, transversality and bubbles; the forward-solution theory (A.14)-(A.17) with exact determinacy conditions; Wicksellian, exogenous-rate, Taylor-rule, inertial and money-growth regimes, linear and exact nonlinear (implicit-function theorem on bounded sequences, second-order accuracy); non-separable utility, calibration and the short-period limit; global perfect-foresight dynamics, self-fulfilling deflations, money-targeting dynamics, timing and the Schmitt-Grohe-Uribe example.
source: Michael Woodford, Interest and Prices: Foundations of a Theory of Monetary Policy, Princeton University Press, 2003, Chapter 2, pp. 61-138, and Appendix A, pp. 627-655.
